entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An unfathomably old planeswalker dragon who has shaped entire planes, vanquished cataclysmic forces and been reborn at least twice.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ugin's twin, as cunning and powerful but far more interested in world domination.

events.summary: Over his long life Ugin shapes entire planes, vanquishes cataclysmic forces and is reborn at least twice.
events.quote: Ugin has shaped entire planes, vanquished cataclysmic forces, and been reborn at least twice.

relations.quote: He's as cunning and powerful as his twin, Nicol Bolas
